Prior legislation: Ord. of 7-11-11(2).

1

Editor’s note—An ordinance adopted July 11, 2011, repealed ch. 30 and enacted a new chapter as set out herein. The former ch. 30, §§ 30-1—30-5, 30-16—30-18, 30-20—30-43, and 30-47—30-54, pertained to similar subject matter and derived from §§ 1441—1444 of the Rev. Ords. of 1962; § 8 of an ordinance adopted March 20, 1978; an ordinance adopted Oct. 25, 1993; an ordinance adopted Jan. 9, 1995; an ordinance adopted Feb. 5, 1996; an ordinance adopted Jan. 24, 2000; an ordinance adopted Oct. 7, 2002; an ordinance adopted Oct. 11, 2005; an ordinance adopted Sept. 15, 2008; and an ordinance adopted July 12, 2010.

Cross reference—Motor vehicles, Ch. 20, vehicle licenses and permits for taxicabs/limousines operating on grounds of Burlington International Airport, App. E, § 2.1 et seq.
